## SuperSubtitler 0.3.3 — no source archive inside the EXE

Download both files into one folder: `SuperSubtitlerGUI.exe` (the window) and `SuperSubtitler.exe` (the engine).

### 📦 Smaller and tidier
- `SuperSubtitler.exe` no longer carries its own source code and no longer writes a `src\` folder on first run. The source of every version is on GitHub: in the repository, and on every release page as a download of exactly that version (the "Source code" files below).
- A `src\` folder left by an earlier version is no longer used — you can delete it.

Nothing else changes; settings, models and the runtime stay as they are.

The exes are not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen may warn — "More info" → "Run anyway". Built by GitHub Actions.
